_what: AWQ x int4_protected combined-memory measurement (Phase 6O), via phase6l LIVE tensor introspection (model_weights_gb) -- the REAL number the stack bench's max_memory_allocated proxy could not give.
config: mml=8192, b-list 96/128, max-tokens 128 (under-saturated for AWQ -> density RATIO not computed; weight numbers are valid regardless)

hbm_gb_total.note: awq_protected - awq_bf16 = the int4 KV path cost (4.38GB sidecars + CUDA-graph pools) ON TOP of the AWQ-shrunk weights

findings.awq_shrinks_weights: 14.25 -> 5.571 GB (2.56x, -8.68 GB) -- measured via live introspection, vs the broken proxy's '0.021 GB' in stack_fixed.json
findings.composition_proven: weight saving IDENTICAL with bf16 KV (5.571) and int4 KV (5.571) -> AWQ weight-quant and int4_protected KV are ORTHOGONAL; the int4 path does not interfere with weight quantization. They COMPOSE at the memory level.
findings.stack_total: footprint = AWQ-shrunk weights (5.57 GB) + int4 KV+sidecars. Both compression effects present and additive.

caveats.density_ratio_not_computed: this run used max-tokens 128 + b-list 96,128 -> AWQ freed ~8.7GB which became extra KV budget, so the cells did NOT saturate the block limit (CEILING_NOT_REACHED). The concurrent-seqs-per-GB density RATIO for the AWQ stack is therefore not measured here; a higher-pressure re-run (--b-list 128,192,256 --max-tokens 512) would compute it. The WEIGHT-saving + composition result above does NOT depend on saturation.
caveats.report_json_aggregate: the top-level report.json hbm_accounting keys on bf16/protected and shows null for the awq_* cells; the real numbers are in the per-cell JSONs (phase6l_awq_*_mml8192_B128.json), captured here.
